resources.string:
Camera Footage Area
 This area displays the live feed from your mobile device's camera, constantly scanning the road for traffic signs.


Bounding Boxes and Labels
 When a traffic sign is recognized, the app highlights it with a bounding box in the camera footage area and assigns a label indicating its type. These visual cues help you quickly identify the detected traffic signs in real-time.


Top Three Recognized Traffic Signs
 The left panel of the screen displays images of the top three recognized traffic signs along with their names. This allows you to identify the most relevant traffic signs without looking away from the road.


Inference Time
 Displayed at the top-left corner of the screen, the inference time (in milliseconds) indicates how quickly the app processes and recognizes traffic signs in real-time.

 Included Traffic Signs:
 APP SIGN NAMES — LTO SIGN NAMES
 Limit 30 — Maximum Speed Restriction 30
 Limit 50 — Maximum Speed Restriction 50
 Limit 60 — Maximum Speed Restriction 60
 Limit 80 — Maximum Speed Restriction 80
 Stop — Stop Sign
 Curve Left — Curve (left)
 Curve Right — Curve (right)
 Slippery — Slippery When Wet
 Traffic Lights — Traffic Lights Ahead
 Keep Right — Keep Right
 Keep Left — Keep Left
 No Left Turn — No Left Turn
 No Right Turn — No Right Turn
 No U-Turn — No U-Turn
